column3: “to fulfill a special vow” renders “to fulfill (pala’) a vow” (also in verse 8).
NASB supplies “of an ephah” (also in verses 6 and 9).
“a bull” renders “a son of the herd” (also in verse 9).
“lift up an offering” renders “offer up a contribution (terumah)” (also in verses 20–21).
“one bull” renders “one young bull, a son of the herd”; “unintentionally” renders “by inadvertence (shegagah).”
“defiantly” renders “with a high hand,” and “his people” renders “its people.”
